summary.business_type: B2B Digital Agency (SEO, Web Design, Digital Marketing)
top_findings: CRITICAL: Server instability - 503 errors on robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and intermittent site pages
CRITICAL: Services page shows 'No services published yet' - blocking conversion
HIGH: Duplicate team entries (4 identical CEO/founder names) raises credibility concerns
HIGH: Blog contains URL spam content instead of original articles
HIGH: Missing ProfessionalService and Service schema markup
quick_wins: Fix 503 server errors - engage Hostinger support immediately
Complete the Services page with actual service descriptions
Fix team section - remove duplicate placeholder entries
Add complete LocalBusiness address with geo coordinates
Remove or fix the URL-spam blog post

findings.title: Server Instability - 503 Errors
findings.description: Core SEO files (robots.txt, sitemap.xml) return HTTP 503 Service Unavailable. Homepage cached but origin unstable. This blocks search engine crawlers from discovering site structure.
findings.recommendation: Engage Hostinger support to investigate server load, memory limits, or application crashes. The Next.js app may be hitting resource limits.

findings.title: Missing Security Headers
findings.description: Only Content-Security-Policy: upgrade-insecure-requests present. Missing HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options, Permissions-Policy.
findings.recommendation: Configure Next.js headers in next.config.js to add full security header suite.

findings.title: Sitemap Unreliable
findings.description: When accessible, sitemap contains double-slash URL malformations (https://titangrowthhub.com//about). This creates duplicate URL signals.
findings.recommendation: Fix sitemap generation to remove double-slash prefix in URL paths.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Homepage title clearly communicates value proposition
Services categories defined (Web Design, SEO, Digital Marketing, Branding)
Contact form with budget ranges captures lead intent

findings.title: Services Page Empty
findings.description: Services page displays 'No services published yet' - this is a conversion blocker for a digital agency selling services.
findings.recommendation: Immediately populate with detailed service descriptions, deliverables, and pricing ranges.

findings.title: Team Section Contains Duplicates
findings.description: About page shows 4 identical team members named 'Sharah Alena, CEO & Founder'. This signals placeholder content and damages credibility.
findings.recommendation: Update with actual team member names, titles, and biographies, or remove duplicate entries.

findings.title: Blog Contains URL Spam
findings.description: Single visible blog post contains a collection of external URLs rather than original content. This is thin/spam content that can harm site quality signals.
findings.recommendation: Remove URL-spam content. Publish original, high-quality articles demonstrating expertise.

findings.title: Missing E-E-A-T Signals
findings.description: No author credentials, certifications, awards, or verifiable case studies. '4.9 Rating' claim has no linked source.
findings.recommendation: Add team credentials, client testimonials with names/companies, case studies with results, and link to review sources.

findings.title: Brand Inconsistency
findings.description: Site references both 'Titan Growth Hub' and 'Avista Digital Agency' suggesting incomplete rebrand.
findings.recommendation: Complete rebrand to single identity (Titan Growth Hub) across all pages.

findings.title: Missing Meta Descriptions
findings.description: About, Services, and Blog pages have no meta descriptions detected.
findings.recommendation: Add unique, compelling meta descriptions (150-160 chars) to all pages.

findings.title: Page-Type Mismatch
findings.description: Homepage optimized as lead-gen page but SERP intent for 'digital marketing agency Pakistan' expects service directory/comparison. SXO score: 52/100.
findings.recommendation: Add service comparison table, pricing ranges, and client case studies to homepage.

findings.title: Thin Content on Key Pages
findings.description: Services page has no content. Homepage has 1,641 words vs competitor average of 3,000+.
findings.recommendation: Expand service descriptions and add detailed methodology sections.

findings.title: Incomplete LocalBusiness Address
findings.description: LocalBusiness schema only has addressCountry. Missing streetAddress, addressLocality, addressRegion, postalCode, and geo coordinates.
findings.recommendation: Complete PostalAddress with full address details and add GeoCoordinates for local SEO.

findings.title: Missing ProfessionalService Schema
findings.description: Digital agency should have ProfessionalService schema for proper categorization.
findings.recommendation: Add ProfessionalService schema with serviceType, areaServed, and provider references.

findings.title: Missing Service Schema
findings.description: Individual services (SEO, Web Design, etc.) not marked up.
findings.recommendation: Add Service schema for each core offering with pricing information.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema
findings.description: No breadcrumb schema for site navigation structure.
findings.recommendation: Implement BreadcrumbList schema on all content pages.

categories.name: Performance (CWV)
what_works: Next.js SSR for fast initial render

findings.title: No Field Data Available
findings.description: Cannot verify Core Web Vitals without CrUX data. Lab estimate only.
findings.recommendation: Add Web Vitals library and send metrics to analytics. Configure PageSpeed API for field data.

findings.title: Images Not Optimized
findings.description: No srcset, lazy loading, or Next.js Image component detected.
findings.recommendation: Implement Next.js <Image> component with automatic WebP/AVIF conversion and lazy loading.

findings.title: Bundle Size Unknown
findings.description: JavaScript bundle size not audited. Multiple chunks loading async.
findings.recommendation: Run next/bundle-analyzer to identify optimization opportunities.

findings.title: Server 503s Block AI Crawlers
findings.description: Intermittent 503 errors prevent AI crawlers from accessing content reliably.
findings.recommendation: Fix server stability as top priority - this blocks all AI search indexing.

findings.title: Unverifiable '#1' Claim
findings.description: Claims 'Pakistan's #1 SEO Agency' without third-party verification or awards.
findings.recommendation: Link to industry rankings, awards, or audited case studies to support claims.

findings.title: Poor Citability Score
findings.description: FAQ sections appear to have placeholder content. No specific statistics or data points for citation.
findings.recommendation: Add concrete metrics (e.g., 'Average traffic increase: X% over 6 months') with source data.

categories.name: Visual & Mobile
what_works: H1 visible above fold on desktop

findings.title: Mobile H1 Cut Off
findings.description: On mobile (375x812), H1 requires scrolling to view. Mobile-first indexing affected.
findings.recommendation: Reduce hero height on mobile to 50-60vh. Ensure H1 and CTA visible without scrolling.

findings.title: No Responsive Images
findings.description: No srcset or picture elements detected for responsive breakpoints.
findings.recommendation: Implement Next.js Image component with responsive sizing.

findings.title: Font Sizes Small on Mobile
findings.description: Some text appears small on mobile devices.
findings.recommendation: Ensure minimum 14-16px for body text. Verify heading hierarchy maintained.

items.details: Engage Hostinger support to investigate origin server instability. Check memory limits, CPU usage, and Next.js application health.
Add detailed descriptions for all services (Web Design, SEO, Digital Marketing, Branding) with deliverables and pricing ranges.
Update About page with actual team member information or remove placeholder duplicates.
Add full postal address, geo coordinates, email, and telephone to LocalBusiness schema.
Implement schema for agency categorization and individual service offerings.
Delete or rewrite the spam blog post. Create 2-3 original articles demonstrating SEO expertise.
Write unique meta descriptions for About, Services, Blog, FAQs, and Contact pages.
Create 5+ Pakistan-specific case studies with metrics, client names (with permission), and results.
Include team credentials, certifications, awards, and link to third-party review sources.
Convert all images to Next.js Image component with WebP/AVIF and lazy loading.
Adjust hero section so H1 and CTA are visible above fold on mobile devices.
Install web-vitals library and configure analytics dashboard for CWV tracking.

items.task: Complete rebrand to Titan Growth Hub
items.details: Remove all references to 'Avista Digital Agency' across the site.
Configure HSTS, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options in Next.js config.
